Price runs the 20-bar low (high) and closes back inside, then within 10 bars a candle closes beyond the last swing high (low) = market-structure shift, leaving a fair value gap in the move → buy (sell) limit at the gap edge, stop beyond the swept extreme (0.5–3×ATR). Inputs are points (1/10 pip). Gold pip 0.1 → sweep $0.30, minimum candle $0.20, stop $5, target $13. BTC auto pip assumed $1 → point $0.10 → sweep $3, minimum candle $2, stop $50, target $130. EMA50: long only above, short only below. Pivots length 5, last 20 highs and 20 lows. Sweep trades past a stored level by the minimum and closes back inside; the sweep candle needs wick ≥35% and body ≤65%. Confirm on that bar or within the next 2: bullish (bearish) and a close through the sweep candle's midline. Next-bar open, 10-bar cooldown, one position. Desk stats subtract the Vantage round trip plus slippage. Unseen test: the point bracket and a wick-stop variant both trail the current system after costs, and the $50 BTC stop sits inside the spread. Display only, no alerts.
